title: SCP-745, Headlights
description: Two bright lights in the dark might not be a car… they might be hunting you.
body:
Headlights adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-745, also known as Headlights.


Headlights is a fast, predatory entity that roams the world at night in small groups of one to three. Recognizable by the eerie glow of their “headlights,” these creatures can detect players from great distances. They become hostile if the player is nearby in well-lit areas or if the player is riding another entity. At longer ranges, SCP-745  will increases its speed the further away the target is. Once within five blocks, it can leap forward with enough force to break blocks in its path, dealing massive damage. With high health, high speed, and powerful attacks, Headlights are a serious nighttime threat.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-745 spawn?

SCP-745 can spawn in the overworld at night on the surface like a normal monster. However, there can only be a few instance of SCP-745

</details>



![SCP-745](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/035e6cebbd2a015e5d43fc977e32ed25647077b8.png)

SCP-745 are large predators, spawning only at night in groups of one to three. Their most distinctive feature is the bright, glowing light on their heads, visible even from afar. They can detect players from 80 block long distances. If the player is in a nearby lit area (light level 13 or above) or is riding another entity, SCP-745 will immediately become aggressive. At distances over 20 blocks, they're speed increases rapidly. Once within five blocks, they can leap forward and break blocks. Combined with their high health and damage, Headlights make the night a far deadlier place.
